description: A Policy within the Pension Administration.

accrual_end_date.description: The date at which accrual of this Coverage ends.

accrual_start_date.description: The date at which accrual of this Coverage starts.

active_policy_id.description: The `policy_id` of the Policy that is active with regards to this Policy.

actuarial_analysis_regulation_id.description: Grouping id for this Policy from the annual work analysis.

annual_salary.description: The current annual Salary of the Participant in this Employment.

cost_center.description: The cost center of this policy

created_at.description: The date and time when this Policy was created in the Pension Administration.

current_pension_age.description: The age of the participant at the `pension_date`.

deduction_disability_exemption_factor.description: The deduction on the disability exemption factor.

disability_exemption_factor.description: The factor in which this Incapacitated Participant is eligible for premium waiver.

disability_factor.description: The factor in which this Participant is incapacitated.

disability_policy_id.description: The `policy_id` of the Policy that is the disability Policy with regards to this Policy.

effective_from.description: The date from which this Policy is in effect. (Aka the start date of the Policy).

effective_until.description: The Date up to which (and not including) this Policy is in effect. (Aka the end date of the Policy).

employer.description: Information about the Employer whose Employment of the Main Insured led to the creation of this Policy.

employer_id.description: The Id of the Employer whose Employment of the Main Insured led to the creation of this Policy.

employer_name.description: The Name of the Employer whose Employment of the Main Insured led to the creation of this Policy.

employment_ended_at.description: The Date at which Employment with this Employer ended.

employment_started_at.description: The Date at which Employment with this Employer started.

gross_net.description: Is this a gross or a net policy.

leave_of_absence_policy_id.description: The Id of the leave of absence policy.

leave_of_absence_type.description: The type of the absent of leave.

migration_average_parttime_factor.description: The average parttime factor at migration.

parttime_factor.description: The factor with regards to the full-time working time for this Employment.

parttime_factor_before_end_employment.description: The parttime factor just before the end of the employment, fulltime is represented as 1. This property is filled in mutation 2 and is emptied by mutation 41.

pension_date.description: The date at which the Participant is expected to retire.

pension_date_chosen.description: The date at which the Participant has chosen to retire.

pension_factor.description: The factor in which this Participant is retired. 1 = 100%.

pension_policy_id.description: The `policy_id` of the Policy that has been split off to host current benefits that are being disbursed.

policy_id.description: A logical and unique policy identifier for this policy in the Pension Administration.

policy_id_previous_administrator.description: The id of the Policy at the previous administrator.

pre_conversion_dossier_id.description: The 'dossier_id' where this policy was converted from.

pre_conversion_participant_id.description: The 'participant_id' where this policy was converted from.

salary.description: The current Salary of the Participant in this Employment.

scheme.description: The Scheme on which this Policy is based.

contract_id.description: The Id of the Contract in which this Scheme is defined.

product_name.description: The Name of the Product on which this Scheme is based.

scheme_id.description: The Unique Id for this Scheme.

updated_at.description: The date and time when this Policy was last updated in the Pension Administration.

period_year.description: The year the factor A belongs to.

years_accrual_factor.description: The building-up factor for this Policy.
